first_after_destroy.scope: uordblks is allocator-reported allocated arena space, not a reachability/live-object proof; fordblks is free allocator space which can remain resident.

last_after_destroy.scope: uordblks is allocator-reported allocated arena space, not a reachability/live-object proof; fordblks is free allocator space which can remain resident.

before_trim.scope: uordblks is allocator-reported allocated arena space, not a reachability/live-object proof; fordblks is free allocator space which can remain resident.

after_trim.scope: uordblks is allocator-reported allocated arena space, not a reachability/live-object proof; fordblks is free allocator space which can remain resident.

after_wait2s.scope: uordblks is allocator-reported allocated arena space, not a reachability/live-object proof; fordblks is free allocator space which can remain resident.

final_trim.interpretation: A positive RSS drop establishes reclaimable allocator pages at this instant only. It does not prove absence of leaks; zero drop is not proof of a leak. Never use this post-test trim as the production acceptance baseline.

before-create.scope: glibc malloc_info XML, not process RSS and not BPU/CMA/DMA

after-first-destroy.scope: glibc malloc_info XML, not process RSS and not BPU/CMA/DMA

before-final-trim.scope: glibc malloc_info XML, not process RSS and not BPU/CMA/DMA

after-final-trim.scope: glibc malloc_info XML, not process RSS and not BPU/CMA/DMA

limits: Resources include bounded test-driver JSON allocations. The final three simultaneously retained RapidJSON snapshots can contribute roughly64-128KiB to uordblks differences; avoid treating such small differences as SDK live-object growth.
mallinfo2 allocator-reported allocated space is not a full live/reachable-object census, and does not include BPU/CMA/DMA allocations.
RSS and allocator free/allocated figures measure different things. Compare actual after_destroy growth, long-tail allocation trends, XML heaps, and external system resource logs.
This analyzer deliberately emits observations instead of an automatic no-leak verdict. Production004/005 were not modified or per-cycle trimmed.
